decisions.reason: As a test vinyl series it is somewhat experimental, but it builds directly on the firm's existing catalog, label, and collector-focused physical-media know-how, so management is likely to keep it while learning from early demand signals.

A German new wave compilation series fits very closely with the firm's curatorial strengths, catalog depth, and audience for niche physical releases, giving it strong absorptive-capacity support and a good case to remain on the market.
